hypothesis: MPLC: multi-scale (8/20/50px) oriented log-Gabor phase congruency on RTP, isostatic gravity and detrended elevation, plus cross-source PC concordance and RTP structure-tensor orientation coherence, added to a 39-band HGB, catches low-amplitude buried fault steps that amplitude-biased gradient stacks miss.
mechanism: Contrast-invariant local-phase alignment across scales (Kovesi PC with frequency-spread weighting); dots emitted by dotted greedy max-cover on E[k], 37,654 budget, <=2px catalogue prune, visible faults masked pixel-exact.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts, mafic dikes, paleo-shoreline risers, road/terrace edges are also phase-congruent steps; mitigated by cross-source concordance + supervised HGB, decided by holdout.

holdout.evaluator: KANLER-HOLDOUT-v1 = vendor gems57-pooled-hide-v2 (whole <=12px segments, quadrant domains eroded 12px, seed 20, mode=all) + quadrant-blocked training + vendor pooled_summary paired 20km block bootstrap
holdout.champion_caveat: Champion is a fixed raster built with the full catalogue; catalogue hide-and-recover is anti-aligned with its 2px prune (GEMSDOE31 disclosure). Its low value here is NOT evidence it would score low live, and beating it on this instrument is not a promotion argument.
holdout.exp3_note: Catalogue holdout prefers 44,090 dots; the only live (OWNER-REPORTED) budget ladder on the champion field prefers 37,654. Final file uses 37,654; conflict disclosed.

sgmc_proxy_computed.reading: On off-catalogue USGS SGMC faults (>300m from catalogue) the candidate trails the champion. SGMC is pre-Quaternary-inclusive and is a proxy, not the hidden truth, but this regression blocks any claim of expected live superiority.
